name: team-coordination
description: Start or reuse an Astra project-analysis chat that forms tailored leader and teammate chats in the Codex sidebar; coordinate roles, ownership and evidence, and diagnose stalled collaboration with doctor.

interface.shortDescription: Astra teams, internal decisions and collaboration doctor
interface.longDescription: Start or reuse a user-requested Astra sidebar team with internal decision routing. Collaboration doctor separates configured tool policy, exact pending actions, stale packets, message receipts and owner uncertainty, then guides bounded supported recovery. Its diagnostic command is read-only and does not fabricate approvals or attest native popup suppression. Installation alone creates no chats or active-project adoption.
defaultPrompt: Use $team-coordination to form or reuse the Astra-led sidebar team and complete my goal; I delegate necessary collaboration to the leader and members, with decisions handled inside the team and doctor used to diagnose and recover unexpected approvals or stalls within the existing task.
